key_insight: OOPMAS generates the agent roles and workflow for each individual query, using object-oriented agents and a dynamic skill library to adapt multi-agent coordination without training.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical way to deploy mixed-task LLM systems that can self-configure per request, which is useful for real-world pipelines with varying difficulty and task types.
method: Represents each agent as a class with role, tools, and persistent state.
Builds the workflow as an executable main function over agent objects.
Stores execution feedback as structured lessons in a dynamic skill library for in-context improvement.
evidence_signal: On a mixed benchmark covering code, math, and QA, OOPMAS reaches 89.6% accuracy, beating the strongest baseline by 18.1 points and scaling to 92.4% with the strongest backbone.
watch_item: Performance depends on reliable execution feedback and prompt-based skill accumulation, so results may vary with backbone quality, tool availability, and workflow complexity.
paper_title: OOPMAS: Object-Oriented Multi-Agent Systems for Query-Level Workflow Generation
